anatomy.name: Root
anatomy.notes: aria-labelledby points at the Title; role, children and aria-labelledby are not overridable.

anatomy.name: Title

anatomy.name: TitleLink
anatomy.notes: Named by the title text. Inside the heading, never around it; its ::after covers the card (Root is the positioning context).
anatomy.action: Navigates to href; a click anywhere on the card opens the course.

anatomy.name: Progress
anatomy.notes: Named by the Title through aria-labelledby.

anatomy.when: author, duration or certified is set

anatomy.name: Separator
anatomy.when: author and duration are both set
anatomy.notes: A dot drawn by CSS, aria-hidden.

figma.note: Optional in code but Figma has no Has duration (known gap, migration Tier 0).
Previewed as a Has progress variant.

constraints.reason: ProgressBar has no inverted treatment: its track and fill aren't contrast-checked against the inverted container. Inverted footer cards show duration and certified only.
duration holds the duration only. Pass the author in author, never packed into duration ("Jon Kabat-Zinn · 2 hours"): a merged string hides the author from consumers, agents and Figma.
Pass plain values. The component draws the separator between author and duration (aria-hidden); never type "·" or add a separator before Certified.

states.name: default
states.notes: Without href the card is static and has no interactive states.

states.name: hover
states.trigger: :hover on TitleLink (its overlay covers the card)
states.notes: Linked cards only: the thumbnail fades.

states.name: focus-visible
states.notes: The focus ring is drawn on the Thumbnail, and it fades as on hover (ADR-028 amendment 2026-11-13).

ariaAttributes: Root is a native <article>, aria-labelledby → the title Heading's id (useId); role, children and aria-labelledby are omitted from the props type so consumers cannot override them
thumbnailAlt (pass a meaningful description of the course image, or empty string if the title already provides context)
Progress: ProgressBar aria-labelledby → the title id (no duplicated '<title> progress' string)
TitleLink (href set): a plain <a> inside the heading, named by the title text; its stretched ::after makes the whole card a click target

keyboardInteractions.action: Moves focus to the TitleLink when href is set; without href the card has no tab stop

accessibility.notes: Without href the card does not navigate: the consumer must give the course another way in. Focus on the link shows as the ring on the thumbnail; the brand ring passes 3:1 on the inverted container too (token-contrast-check).

position.reason: Positioning context for the TitleLink overlay.

opacity.reason: Same fade as CardVertical. No opacity token scale exists.
Matches hover. No opacity token scale exists.

min-width.reason: Lets a flex child shrink below its content width.

color.reason: The heading owns the title colour, inverted included.

text-decoration.reason: The whole card is the target; the thumbnail fade is the hover cue.

color.reason: Overrides the reset's a:hover colour, which would recolour the title and fail contrast on the inverted band.

outline.reason: The ring is drawn on the Thumbnail instead (ADR-028 amendment 2026-11-13).

decisions.decision: Root is a native <article>, not a div with role=article.
decisions.reason: First rule of ARIA: use the native element when one carries the role. Same role and behaviour, simpler markup; role stays omitted from the props type.

decisions.decision: The inverted variant colors its text through Heading color="inverted" and Text color="inverted-subtle". Only the badge icon needs a CSS Module override (.inverted .badge svg).
decisions.reason: Heading and Text own their color through the color prop; a color rule on the card root bypasses the typography API.

decisions.decision: The card opens its course through an optional href: a stretched link, the <a> inside the heading with an ::after covering Root. Same pattern as CardVertical.
decisions.reason: The title names the link and the heading stays a heading (Inclusive Components, Cards; WCAG 2.4.4). The cost is that the card's text can't be selected with the pointer.

decisions.decision: Keyboard focus on the link shows as the focus ring on the thumbnail, plus the hover fade.
decisions.reason: The card has no border; the thumbnail is its one clear edge. The ring keeps the ADR-028 tokens and contrast gate.

ruledOut.option: Wrapping the card in an <a>, or an onClick on Root
ruledOut.reason: Kept consistent with CardVertical, where the wrap would nest buttons in a link; a click handler on Root isn't reachable by keyboard and has no link semantics.
